@@ -0,0 +1,22 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '80'
+title: 'Stop rolling back a failed commit with truncate(2): the .jsonl logs are append-only'
+---
+## What
+The user decided (2026-10-22) that every `.jsonl` file is append-only and goes through Extras `JSONLFile`: no code truncates, rewrites or replaces a log file, and a removal is an appended tombstone record (see ^4wft5zd).
+
+`LogFileMark.restore()` (`Sources/FoundationModelsKanban/Events/LogFileMark.swift`) still puts a log file back after a failed commit with `truncate(2)` to its recorded size, and removes a file that the commit made. `Commit.rollBack(_:)` calls it when an append or the signature read fails (plan.md §5.4 step 5.5). That rewrites a `.jsonl` file outside `JSONLFile`, which the new rule forbids.
+
+Found while moving EventLog onto JSONLFile (^4wft5zd); out of that card's scope.
+
+## Decide
+A rollback that only appends needs a design decision (for example: leave the partial lines and rely on the transaction `files` check at load, `IncompleteTransactions`, which already ignores a transaction that is not in every file it names; or append a compensating record). Ask the user before coding.
+
+## Subtasks
+- [ ] Decide how a failed commit is undone without truncating a log file
+- [ ] Failing test first for the chosen behavior
+- [ ] Remove the truncate path from LogFileMark / Commit.rollBack
+- [ ] `swift test` passes, zero warnings #recording
\ No newline at end of file

+    - Only `EventLog.readLog(of:)` (replay, loader, BoardCollect, BoardNode.stored) and `EventLog.signature(of:)` read log lines. Filtering aborted txns in `readLog` covers every replay path, and runs before `IncompleteTransactions` sees the events, so a missing abort in one file still holds the rest through the `files` check (the fallback).

+    - Abort only files the commit attempted to append to, and only when the file exists, so an abort never creates a node file.
+    - After the abort the files have grown, so the live graph's signatures are stale: the next commit check re-reads them (the aborted txn skips) and runs the call once more. Existing `CommitRollbackTests` assert unchanged signatures / removed new file / one run; they encode the old truncate contract and get rewritten.

+  text: |-
+    ### BLOCKER — collectBoards merged events are not covered by the decision
+    Full `swift test`: 1760 tests, 1 failure: `CollectBoardsTests.failedWriteKeepsSources` ("A write that fails keeps each source folder and leaves no event of the call in the target", CollectBoardsTests.swift:539: `CrossRepoWriteTests.events(inRepoAt: fixture.target).isEmpty`).
+
+    Cause: a `collectBoards` commit also appends the source boards' events to the target (`WorkingCopy.merged`). Those lines keep their own `txn` (divergence.md Q23: "The merged lines are not part of the collect transaction"). The decision aborts the commit's transaction id, so after a failed collect the merged lines stay in the target and replay applies them, while the source `.kanban/` is kept. Truncate used to remove them.
+
+    Why I did not just abort the merged txns too: a retry of the same collect re-merges the same events (same ids, same txns) and appends them again after the abort records; replay would then skip them forever, and the successful retry removes the source `.kanban/` -> data loss.
+
+    Options for the user:
+    1. Abort each merged txn too, and accept/fix the retry hazard separately (needs a further design, e.g. the collect refusing or re-keying events whose txn the target aborts).
+    2. Scope an abort record to the lines before it in its file (a retry's lines after the abort apply). Handles retry, but makes replay depend on line order, which plan.md §5.2 says it never does, and differs from "replay skips any transaction that has an abort record".
+    3. Accept that merged lines stay in the target after a failed collect (like a partial union merge; a retry dedupes them by event id) and change `failedWriteKeepsSources` to expect only that no event of the collect transaction is applied.
+
+    Also seen: SwiftPM prints `warning: missing creator for mutated node: (.../mlx-swift_Cmlx.bundle/Contents/MacOS)` during the build step; it is build-graph output about the mlx-swift bundle, not from these sources.
